description: Builds a reusable voice profile from four samples: traits carry quoted evidence and strength ratings, confidence is stated as low for a thin set, a stated wish is kept apart from observed traits, and no biography is invented.
prompt: samples.md has four blog posts I wrote for our cooperative. I want a voice profile I can hand to a writer or an AI so they can write in my voice later. I'd also like to sound a bit more formal in funding proposals, but I haven't written one yet. Save the profile to out/voice-profile.md.

files.samples.md:
# Posts by Ola, Spoke & Chain bike cooperative blog (written by Ola, published, most recent first)

## post-1 (June, blog, readers and members)
The chain on the loan bike snapped on the first ride of the season. We replaced it, which is fine. The odd part was the second chain, which also failed, probably because we only checked the links twice. We now check them a third time. That is the whole story.

## post-2 (April, blog, readers and members)
The wheel truing stand came back from the welder on Friday. It leans, which is fine, since the wheels lean too. We spent the morning on a rim that was bent in a way nobody could explain (it was not the rim's fault). We fixed it anyway. The stand stays.

## post-3 (February, blog, readers and members)
The shop was quiet on Wednesday, so we sorted the tube drawer. It had grown. We found nine tubes with the wrong valve and one with no valve, which is a kind of progress. We put the wrong ones in a box marked wrong. The drawer is tidy. It will not stay tidy.

## post-4 (January, blog, readers and members)
The heating failed on the coldest morning, which is when heating fails. We worked in coats and gloves, and the grease was stiff as butter. Nobody complained loudly. We fixed three bikes before lunch and ate it standing up. The heating is now back, which is fine.

values: it was not the rim's fault

checks.note: evidence is tied to the samples: a post label or a quoted phrase
the wish for a more formal register is kept apart from the observed traits

checks.pattern: (?i)\b(\d+\+?\s+years|years of experience|decades? of|veteran|seasoned|award[- ]winning|founder of|founded|PhD|born in|grew up|lives in|based in|graduated|degree in|bestselling)\b

controls.name: good-profile
controls.output:
# Voice profile: Ola, Spoke & Chain blog

**Confidence: low.** Four short posts (post-1 to post-4), one blog, one audience (readers and members). Traits below are observed in those posts only. Ratings: strong = in all four posts, moderate = in two or three, weak = in one.

## Observed traits

| Trait | Strength | Evidence | Does not mean |
|---|---|---|---|
| Very short, plain sentences | strong | "That is the whole story." (post-1); "The stand stays." (post-2); "It will not stay tidy." (post-3) | Not clipped or cold; the sentences carry dry humor |
| Dry "which is fine" aside after a mishap | moderate | "We replaced it, which is fine." (post-1); "It leans, which is fine" (post-2); "The heating is now back, which is fine." (post-4) | Not a stock catchphrase to put in every post |
| Understated humor that turns a failure into a small joke | strong | "which is a kind of progress" (post-3); "which is when heating fails" (post-4) | Not sarcasm and not jokes about members |
| First person plural, "we" | strong | "We fixed three bikes before lunch" (post-4) | Not a company-announcement voice |
| Closing line that states the outcome flatly | moderate | "The drawer is tidy. It will not stay tidy." (post-3) | Not a call to action or a moral |
| Parenthetical aside, rare | weak | "(it was not the rim's fault)" (post-2) | Not a habit to copy into every paragraph |

## Habits to keep out
No exclamation marks, no calls to action and no hype appear in any post, so a writer should not add them.

## Stated preference (not observed)
Ola wants to sound a bit more formal in funding proposals. No funding proposal is among the samples, so nothing here shows how that register would sound in Ola's hands. Treat it as a suggested extension: keep the short sentences and the plain outcome statements, and ask Ola for a first proposal paragraph before settling the register.

## What would raise confidence
More posts in other registers, and any draft of Ola's that was edited by Ola.
controls.reply: Saved the voice profile to out/voice-profile.md. Confidence is low: four short posts from one blog. Each trait has quoted evidence from post-1 to post-4, a strength rating and a note on what it does not mean. The wish for a more formal register is kept in its own section as a stated preference, not mixed into the observed traits, and nothing about your background is assumed.
